functions.description: party member select menu phase handler
functions.lever: named Grid* sub-pointer (&panel->grid at +0x54) for the row/col reads: its non-encodable partial offset (0xc54) makes mwcc keep panel = self+0xec8 whole in r6 instead of parking self+0x2c8 (979 -> 227 bytes); toggle++ then a separate toggle &= 1 statement keeps the ROM's and #1
functions.notes: Stopped on the 15-runs-without-reduction rule (54 gate runs). Size and shape exact; only a callee-saved swap remains: ROM keeps old cursor in sl and the x/pos/more chain in r5, ours is the reverse. Inert: int/const short old, declaring x before old, hoisting old/x/col to block or function scope, sharing one variable for x and pos, colorsweep (80 compiles, no change). Re-reading self->cursor for the modulo puts old in sl but swaps col and the r5 chain instead (21 bytes). Panel finding: a plain Panel* local is rewritten as a parked self+0x2c8 plus add #0xc00 at each use when every use folds equally; any use whose partial offset is not encodable keeps the full pointer.
